# Supply Station

> Supply Station is a Cape Town, South Africa manufacturer of forecourt squeegees and a supplier of forecourt cleaning supplies (garage rolls, pink multi-purpose soap, replacement rubbers and sponges, out-of-order pump covers) for petrol stations and resellers. Formerly traded as UAC Services: same team, same factory, new name. Customers can buy direct or at wholesale/trade pricing. Orders are placed on WhatsApp or by phone on 082 826 1003.

Website: https://thesupplystation.co.za/
Supply Station is a trading name of True Motives 1130 CC.
Last updated: 2026-09-30

## Contact

- Phone / WhatsApp: 082 826 1003 (international: +27 82 826 1003)
- WhatsApp link: https://wa.me/27828261003
- Address: Unit 10, Celie Industrial Park, 4 Celie Road, Retreat, Cape Town, 7945, Western Cape, South Africa
- Factory location (GPS): -34.0731766, 18.4601875
- Park entrance (GPS, use this for directions and courier collections): -34.0732030,18.4606152
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=-34.0732030,18.4606152
- Hours: Monday to Friday 08:00–17:00, Saturday 08:00–13:00, Sunday closed (South African time, SAST)

## Products and prices

All prices are in South African rand (ZAR) and **exclude 15% VAT**. Delivery is extra where it applies.

- Squeegee: R35.00 each. Made by us in Cape Town. The head is a foam block wrapped in shade cloth with a rubber blade, supplied with a handle. Available in 5 colours: red, blue, black, dark grey, light grey.
- Garage Roll: R235.00 each. Forecourt paper towel / jumbo wiper roll, 160mm × 1250m.
- Reject Garage Roll: R190.00 each. Budget-grade roll, approx. 160mm × 1250m (sizes vary).
- Pink Multi Purpose Soap: R450.00 each (25 litre).
- Replacement Squeegee Rubber 5-Pack: R40.00 per pack. Fits our squeegees.
- Replacement Squeegee Sponges 5-Pack: R40.50 per pack. Fits our squeegees.
- Out of Order Cover: R120.00 each. Forecourt pump / bay cover.

Bulk pricing is available on volume (e.g. squeegees, garage rolls, standing orders). Bulk prices are quoted on request, not published. Branded or custom squeegees are available on request for trade customers.

## Who we sell to

- Buy Direct: petrol stations and forecourt operators buying for their own sites, straight from the manufacturer.
- Wholesale / Trade: resellers supplying forecourts or the cleaning trade, at wholesale pricing on volume. A trade price list is available on request.

## Delivery

- Zone 1 (within about 15km of Retreat): free delivery. Areas include Retreat, Steenberg, Tokai, Diep River, Plumstead, Wynberg, Kenilworth, Claremont, Constantia, Bergvliet, Meadowridge, Heathfield, Kenwyn, Lakeside, Muizenberg, Grassy Park, Lotus River, Ottery, Wetton, Crawford, Rondebosch and Newlands.
- Zone 2 (about 15–40km): delivery fee applies, confirmed when you order. Areas include Cape Town CBD, Mowbray, Observatory, Woodstock, Salt River, Kalk Bay, Fish Hoek, Sun Valley, Noordhoek, Hout Bay, Bellville, Parow, Goodwood, Mitchells Plain, Khayelitsha, Table View, Milnerton, Century City and Durbanville.
- Zone 3 (40km+, rest of the Western Cape and South Africa, e.g. Stellenbosch, Somerset West, Paarl, Malmesbury, Worcester): the customer books their own courier to collect from our factory in Retreat.

## How to order

1. Choose products and quantities on the website's order builder (https://thesupplystation.co.za/#orderBuilder), or write your own list.
2. Send the list on WhatsApp to 082 826 1003, or call.
3. We confirm the final price (including any bulk pricing) and delivery.

## Frequently asked questions

- Is Supply Station the same company as UAC Services? Yes. UAC Services is now called Supply Station: same team, same factory in Retreat, Cape Town.
- Do your prices include VAT? No. All listed prices exclude 15% VAT.
- Do you deliver? Yes, with our own vehicles across Cape Town: free in Zone 1, a fee in Zone 2. Outside about 40km, your courier collects from us.
- Do you offer bulk or wholesale pricing? Yes. Ask for a bulk quote or a trade price list on WhatsApp.
- Do you make the squeegees yourselves? Yes. We manufacture our squeegees in Cape Town.
